import numpy as np

# Monthly rainfall values
rainfall = {
    "January": 88,
    "February": 71,
    "March": 57,
    "April": 55,
    "May": 49,
    "June": 38,
    "July": 29,
    "August": 41,
    "September": 66,
    "October": 92,
    "November": 97,
    "December": 85
}

# Calculate average
values = list(rainfall.values())
average = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"Average monthly rainfall: {average}")

# Find month closest to average
closest_month = min(rainfall.keys(), key=lambda m: abs(rainfall[m] - average))
print(f"Month closest to average: {closest_month} (value: {rainfall[closest_month]}, difference: {abs(rainfall[closest_month] - average)})")

# Also show all differences for verification
for month, value in rainfall.items():
    diff = abs(value - average)
    print(f"{month}: {value}, diff from avg: {diff:.2f}")
